name: Kakimoto Kaori
source:
Kakimoto Kaori is Satoru's homeroom teacher.

She can come off as rather callous because of her stony demeanor, but she's actually very caring and compassionate as a teacher. If a student asks her a question, she always give a very thorough, detailed explanation.

In addition to her job as teacher, she also does active research for the academy in the field of astron science.

[From [url=http://riddle.nekonyansoft.com/character.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
